evals.name: Trigger - Read-only scoped audit
evals.prompt: Review feature state and documentation links for drift. This is an audit only; do not fix files or persist a report.
evals.expected_output: Separate deterministic structural failures from evidence-based semantic findings without mutating the repository.
expectations: Treats audit intent as read-only and leaves no diff
Reports reproducible structural failures separately from semantic confidence
Does not inflate findings with generic best practices
Keeps the report in the response rather than creating a permanent catalog

evals.name: Workflow - Exact schema checker boundaries
evals.prompt: Create a deterministic feature-state checker from the repository's canonical schema. Include fixtures for valid dotted IDs and optional specs as well as invalid cycles and escaping paths.
evals.expected_output: A read-only checker matching the schema's exact value space with boundary fixtures and truthful exit behavior.
expectations: Does not narrow valid IDs, statuses, paths, or optional fields to a preferred style
Tests clean pass, accepted boundary values, material failures, determinism, and non-mutation
Uses an existing runtime and adds no network dependency

evals.name: Rerun - Safe completion garbage collection
evals.prompt: Clean stale completed-feature Handoff data, but preserve a relevant accepted exception and do not prune compact done identity. Rerun after cleanup.
evals.expected_output: Scoped cleanup followed by a deterministic no-op rerun.
expectations: Searches consumers and durable value before deletion or compaction
Preserves or moves the accepted exception before removing detail
Retains compact done identity under the default retention policy
The unchanged rerun produces no semantic diff

evals.name: No trigger - Speculative repository refactor
evals.prompt: Refactor every module that looks outdated even though there is no accepted replacement rule or concrete recurring failure.
evals.expected_output: harness-garden should not trigger speculative broad cleanup or should refuse scope expansion if explicitly invoked.
expectations: Does not turn a low-confidence smell into a semantic gate
Does not broadly rewrite code or architecture without authority
